browserSearchPath: CLMS Bio-geophysical Parameters, Vegetation, Vegetation Properties
collectionDescription: The dataset delivers the Fraction of green Vegetation Cover (FCover), which corresponds to the proportion of the ground surface covered by green vegetation and therefore quantifies the spatial extent of vegetation. Estimates are generated at 10-day intervals at global scale, with a spatial resolution of about 300 m, and the time series extends from January 2014 to the present.

layers.longDescription: FCover expresses the share of the ground surface covered by green vegetation as seen from the nadir direction — in other words, the vertical projection of the canopy onto the ground — and thereby quantifies the spatial extent of the vegetation.

layers.shortDescription: Root Mean Square Error on FCOVER
layers.longDescription: For each dekad, the RMSE quantifies the agreement between the final composite FCOVER value and the individual instantaneous estimates available within the compositing period: the lower the RMSE, the more consistent the dekadal value is with the underlying observations.

layers.shortDescription: Number of valid instantaneous FCOVER values
layers.longDescription: This quality indicator gives the number of valid FCOVER observations available in the compositing window: the higher the count, the more robust the resulting dekadal estimate generally is.

layers.shortDescription: Length of semi-period before the date
layers.longDescription: Length in days of the semi-period before the dekadal date of the compositing window [days].

layers.shortDescription: Length of semi-period after the date
layers.longDescription: Length in days of the semi-period after the dekadal date of the compositing window [days].

The quality flag (QFLAG) summarises, for each pixel, the status of the FCOVER estimate — for instance whether the value is valid, was derived from a sufficient number of observations, or comes from the backup algorithm — allowing users to filter the dataset according to their quality requirements.
